entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner had taken this Court to paragraph-16 to show that the petitioner no.1, husband is ready to enter into settlement on an amicable terms and conditions so that this regular acrimony comes to an end.

Dr. Kamaldeo Sharma, learned counsel for the informant submits that the lady is ready to settle on any issue whether on the point of staying together and/or to take different routes so that they can have a better future ahead.

In view of the fair submissions put forward by both the learned counsels, let the matter be sent to the Mediation Center to be taken up by 04.04.2023 and a report be submitted before this Court on 20.04.2023.
It is expected that on 20.04.2023 a positive report will came on the basis of the wise and fruitful decision taken by both the parties.
The interim order dated 23.01.2023 to continue.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Prakash Narayan /-
U T Vikash Mishra And Ors. vs The State Of Bihar And Anr.
